summary: Connect food packaging, brand positioning and launch planning through practical briefs, label reviews and scorecards. Explore the course outline.
lede: Food packaging training helps food product managers, packaging specialists and brand marketers turn buyer needs into practical pack briefs and coordinated launch plans. Participants practise consumer segmentation and brand positioning, set front-of-pack priorities, review label claims and supporting evidence, assess packaging sustainability options, and create artwork review checklists and launch scorecards.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape food product packaging or bring packaged food brands to market. It is designed for roles that need to coordinate product, design, quality, sales and marketing decisions around real packaging and launch outputs.
modules: Food Packaging Briefs and Market Context
Keller CBBE and Food Brand Cues
Food Label Claims and Review Controls
prerequisites: Prior experience in food product, packaging, quality, brand or marketing work is recommended. Familiarity with packaged-food labels or product launches will help you apply the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
